blind.description: A stylized medieval/fantasy standing banner pole. It features a heavy round wooden barrel-style base bound with a riveted metal rim, a vertical central wooden post with turned rings and a pointed spear-like finial at the top, and a horizontal crossbar holding a long vertical banner. The banner fabric is deep red on the sides/back with a cream-coloured center field, ending in a pointed fringed bottom. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and fully stylized with hand-painted textures; no floating, broken, or melted parts.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it resembles a small cross or barbell formed by the horizontal crossbar wrapped in red cloth flanking the pointed central finial, with the wider circular base visible directly below.
blind.height_vs_figure: Slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure, reaching around 6 ft 6 in to the tip of the finial, and about 2 to 2.5 ft wide across the crossbar.

notes: footprint proportion 1.45x off the catalog (2.8 x 2.0 ft)
